1: A steep crooked whitewashed street of sixteenth-century Granada at dawn, skewed angular houses, hard light: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a torn, dishevelled dark doublet, bareheaded, runs down the street toward the camera with his arms flung wide and his mouth open crying out, his face clearly visible and wild with grief, in motion. Nobody else in the street.
3: The dark interior of a Spanish church, one hard shaft of light from a high window: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn dark doublet, kneels alone on the stone floor with his head thrown back, weeping, his fist pressed against his chest, face clearly visible in three-quarter view, anguished but solemn. Tall skewed arches, drifting incense smoke. Nobody else in the shot.
4: A narrow Granada lane at dusk, hard low light: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn dark doublet, stands with his back to a wooden stall and sweeps books and rolled pictures from it onto the cobbles with both hands, scattering them, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, tearful and resolved. Books and pages fall around him. No other people.
6: A bare barred stone cell at night, a single hard shaft of light from a small high window: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a torn shirt, sits on straw against the wall with an iron chain locked to his ankle running to a ring in the wall, head bowed then slowly lifted, his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, exhausted and silent. Nobody else in the shot. No violence shown.
8: A small stone cell lit by a lantern, hard shadows: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn shirt, sits on a wooden stool, listening intently with his face lifted toward a hooded priest who stands in profile at the edge of the frame, partly out of focus, in a plain dark cassock; John's face is clearly visible in three-quarter view, tears on his cheeks, slowly calming.
